description: This file defines data class and functions for parsing invoke error messages, extracting error codes and messages from raw strings or Throwable objects, used for error handling in the application.

classes.name: ParsedInvokeError
classes.description: Data class representing a structured invoke error with code, message, and explicit code flag.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw string to extract error code and message, returning a ParsedInvokeError object.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Extracts and parses error information from a Throwable, with optional fallback message.
